source_text: Τοιοῦτος ὁ περὶ τὸ θεῖον ἀληθὴς λόγος, ὦ ἄνθρωποι Ἕλληνές τε καὶ βάρβαροι, Χαλδαῖοί τε καὶ Ἀσσύριοι, Αἰγύπτιοί τε καὶ Λίβυες, Ἰνδοί τε καὶ Αἰθίοπες, Κελτοί τε καὶ οἱ στρατηγοῦντες Λατῖνοι, πάντες τε οἱ τὴν Εὐρώπην Ἀσίαν τε καὶ Λιβύην κατοικοῦντες, οἷς σύμβουλος ἐγὼ γίνομαι, φιλανθρώπου λόγου ὑπάρχων μαθητὴς καὶ φιλάνθρωπος, ὅπως προσδραμόντες διδαχθῆτε παρ᾿ ἡμῶν, τίς ὁ ὄντως θεὸς καὶ ἡ τούτου εὔτακτος δημιουργία, μὴ προσέχοντες σοφίσμασιν ἐντέχνων λόγων, μηδὲ ματαίοις ἐπαγγελίαις κλεψιλόγων αἱρετικῶν, ἀλλ᾿ ἀληθείας ἀκόμπου ἁπλότητι σεμνῇ, δι᾿ ἧς ἐπιγνώσεως ἐκφεύξεσθε ἐπερχομένην πυρὸς κρίσεως ἀπειλὴν καὶ ταρτάρου ζοφεροῦ ὄμμα ἀφώτιστον, ὑπὸ λόγου φωνῆς μὴ καταλαμφθέν, καὶ βρασμὸν ἀεννάου λίμνης γεέννης φλογός, καὶ ταρταρούχων ἀγγέλων κολαστῶν ὄμμα ἀεὶ μένον ἐν ἀπειλῇ, καὶ σκώληκα σώματος ἀπουσίαν ἐπιστρεφόμενον, ἐπὶ τὸ ἐκβράσαν σῶμα ὡς ἐπιστρέφων.
pass_a_gloss: Such is the true discourse concerning the divine, oh men, Greeks and barbarians, Chaldeans and Assyrians, Egyptians and Libyans, Indians and Ethiopians, Celts and the Latin generals, all those inhabiting Europe and Asia and Libya, to whom I become an advisor, being a student of philanthropic discourse and philanthropic, so that coming you may be taught by us, what the truly existing God is and the well-ordered creation of this one, not paying attention to clever sophistries of cunning words, nor to vain promises of heretical thieves of words, but with the dignified simplicity of unadulterated truth, through which knowledge you will escape the impending threat of the fire judgment and the gloomy eye of Tartarus unextinguished, not being seized by the voice of the word, and the burning of the eternal lake of Gehenna's fire, and the eye of the angels of Tartarus punishing always remaining in threat, and the worm of the body's absence returning, upon the body it has burned as it returns
pass_b_english: I'm speaking to all of you - Greeks and non-Greeks, Chaldeans and Assyrians, Egyptians and Libyans, Indians and Ethiopians, Celts and Latin leaders, and everyone else living in Europe, Asia, and Libya. As someone who advises you, I'm a student of a message that values humanity and I care about people, so I want to teach you about the real God and His well-ordered creation. Don't be fooled by clever arguments or empty promises from people who distort the truth. Instead, let's focus on the simplicity and dignity of unadulterated truth. By understanding this truth, you'll be able to escape the coming judgment by fire and the dark threat of Tartarus, avoiding the voice of condemnation and the eternal punishment of Gehenna's flames, as well as the constant torment of the angels of Tartarus and the relentless worm that consumes the body, which will return to the body it has destroyed, and you will find salvation.
notes: The final clause 'ἐπὶ τὸ ἐκβράσαν σῶμα ὡς ἐπιστρέφων' is corrected to remove the added prepositional direction and qualitative state. The phrase 'ἀπουσίαν ἐπιστρεφόμενον' is also corrected to 'the worm of the body's absence returning' for a more faithful rendering.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: Pass B adds significant content not present in the Greek source, specifically the concluding phrase 'and you will find salvation', which is not in the Locked Greek. Pass B also translates 'κλεψιλόγων' as 'people who distort the truth', whereas Pass A correctly follows the literal 'thieves of words'. Pass B also translates 'στρατηγοῦντες' as 'leaders' (general/commanding) but the Greek specifically refers to those 'commanding' or 'generals'.
reasons: Pass B adds 'and you will find salvation' which is not in the Greek source 'ἐπὶ τὸ ἐκβράσαν σῶμα ὡς ἐπιστρέφων.'

review.notes: greek/hippolytus_refutatio.xml: 'ὀμμα ἀφώτιστον' (gloss: 'unextinguished eye') is not present in the English translation; 'ὀμμα ἀφώτιστον' is not rendered in Pass A or B. Pass A: 'ὀμμα ἀφώτιστον' is not translated. Pass B: 'ὀμμα ἀφώτιστον' is not translated.
reasons: The Greek phrase 'ὀμμα ἀφώτιστον' (unextinguished eye) is not translated in either Pass A or Pass B.
